topic: User management security and guard implementation
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the security of user management features, specifically regarding unauthorized changes to user roles and permissions. Initially, a task was reviewed concerning anonymization/depersonalization. It was determined that relying solely on UI changes is insufficient because the functionality can be easily bypassed (hacked). The core decision was made that server-side checks are necessary to prevent users with access to 'user management' from arbitrarily assigning or revoking administrative rights. A mechanism, including a toggle switch and restoring previous guards, needs to be implemented.
decisions: Implement server-side validation for user role changes in user management.
action_items: [p1] created a separate component (тачка) for the toggle switch to keep the UI clean.
